resources.string: Record a button, then assign a tool or action. Mappings apply inside the editor only. Tool changes during a stroke wait until the pen lifts.
No recorded buttons. Previous Pro Pen 3 mappings are not used; please record your buttons again.
Within 15 seconds, hover over the area below, press ONE button and release it. If nothing happens, hold the button and touch the area, then release. Keyboard-style pen keys can also be recorded.
Recording ended without a complete press and release. Try again. The system may not deliver this button to the app.
This button is already mapped. Edit its existing mapping.
Button recorded. Choose its name, action and behavior, then save.
Up to 32 buttons can be recorded. Remove a mapping before adding another.
Could not save: the mappings contain duplicate or invalid buttons, or exceed the limit.
Requires the pen near the screen. To use a remote key away from the screen, record it there instead.
More than one button was detected. Record one button at a time.
